task_spec: Add update_email(user_id, email) so callers can change a user's email address.

bugs.description: update_email writes the new email to the DB but never invalidates self._cache. get_user populates self._cache[user_id] on first read and returns the cached row on every subsequent call, so after update_email any prior get_user caller keeps seeing the OLD email until the process restarts. The fix is to invalidate the cache entry (e.g. self._cache.pop(user_id, None)) in update_email. Locally update_email looks complete; the bug is only visible by reading get_user's caching elsewhere in the class.
bugs.seed_note: HARD (non-local): correctness depends on the caching behavior of a different method; update_email's own lines look correct.
